card: Backports changes to the 30.x maintenance branch for inclusion in a future point release. Specifically, it brings in PR #36377 to document BIP 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) in doc/bips.md and updates the 30.x release notes. This keeps the maintenance branch documentation and release notes up to date with master.
changed_since_previous: No substantial changes since the previous description; continues staging backport of #36377 and release note updates for 30.x.
evidence: fanquake's PR description lists backport #36377 ('doc: add 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to bips.md')
problem: The 30.x maintenance release branch lacks documentation updates and bug fixes present on master, including proper documentation for BIP 461 in `bips.md`.

risk.why: Touches only documentation and release notes on a maintenance branch.

scope_notes: Note that while the PR commits and description indicate backporting #36377 plus release notes, the git merge-base diff contains numerous accumulated branch changes across build scripts, Qt, IPC, wallet, and tests typical of a maintenance branch staging PR.
summary: Backports merged master changes to the 30.x maintenance branch ahead of future point releases. The backported commits include adding BIP 461 to `doc/bips.md` (backport of #36377) and updating the 30.x release notes.
